fields.why: Long-term care residence appears only as a clinical risk group and in a trial-enrollment limitation, so A's age-only list fits the article's framing; B's 'other' (descriptor, limitation only) is defensible because the brief cites 'older adults in congregate settings' as social position. Either way the level stays 0.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether residence in a long-term care facility, framed as a risk factor, is an SPD ('other') or a clinical status; a rule tying congregate settings to social-position framing would decide it. Both readers left data_focus ev empty; data_focus 'yes' versus 'limited' for an ACIP recommendation built on manufacturer trial results plus the Work Group's pooled RRs is close to the brief's 'figures only cited ... to frame a recommendation' boundary.
